confidence_notes: Sa Pa price figures list $2.01 for an inexpensive meal, $16.74 for a mid-range meal for two, $1.46 for cappuccino, and $1.17 for domestic draft beer. Local menus show cocktails around 119,000–160,000 VND and wine glasses around 68,000–139,000 VND; these anchors use standard or house offerings. Hostel averages vary ($7 per dorm bed and $9–$13 per private room before fees). A hotel source reports a €30 overall median and €28 typical 3-star price. The 1-star estimate is inferred from the lower market, and most price evidence is current to September–October 2026 rather than July, so lodging and July fit are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed; retrieved cost and accommodation sources covered Sa Pa directly, with Vietnam-wide Numbeo prices used only as a cross-check.
